Hormonal Balance Support: Adrenal Cancer Treatment in Tijuana, Mexico
For patients seeking a comprehensive and integrative approach to oncology, the Immunity Therapy Center (ITC) offers a specialized Alternative Adrenal Cancer Treatment in Tijuana Mexico . Recognizing that every patient's biological makeup and cancer stage are unique, ITC focuses on stimulating the body's natural immune system while targeting malignant adrenal cells with advanced, non-toxic protocols. By combining modern medical innovation with holistic care, this program provides a powerful alternative for those looking beyond traditional systemic treatments in a supportive, world-class environment.

Step Into a World-Class Healing Environment in Tijuana, Mexico
Tijuana has evolved into one of the most sophisticated medical destinations in the world, particularly for integrative oncology. Choosing Alternative Adrenal Cancer Treatment in Tijuana Mexico means you are stepping into a community of healing where medical professionals are free to utilize the best of both natural and scientific worlds. At ITC, you are not just a chart number; you are a partner in your own recovery, surrounded by a staff that speaks your language and understands your goals. The proximity to San Diego makes travel seamless, allowing you to focus entirely on your health while enjoying the professional standards of a leading international clinic.
1. Why is Tijuana a hub for alternative adrenal cancer treatments?
Mexico's regulatory environment allows for the use of advanced integrative and alternative therapies that are often caught in long approval processes elsewhere. This allows clinics like ITC to offer the latest innovations in immunotherapy and non-toxic protocols that specifically target endocrine-based malignancies.
2. Can I combine ITC treatments with my current hormone therapy?
Yes, many patients utilize ITC’s protocols as a complementary approach to strengthen their immune system while undergoing conventional hormone management or care elsewhere. Our doctors coordinate closely to ensure therapies do not conflict.
3. How do I know if I am a candidate for the Out-Patient or In-Patient program?
Generally, if you are mobile and have a companion to help with daily logistics, Out-Patient is ideal. In-Patient is reserved for those needing constant nursing care, 24/7 medical monitoring, or those dealing with extreme fatigue from adrenal dysfunction.
4. Are the doctors at ITC board-certified?
Yes, the medical team consists of licensed physicians and specialists with extensive training in both traditional and integrative oncology, ensuring high standards of safety and professional care for every patient.
5. Is English spoken at the clinic?
Absolutely. ITC is designed for international patients, and the entire staff, from doctors to patient coordinators, is fluent in English, ensuring clear communication regarding your treatment plan and progress.
6. What specific tumor markers are monitored for adrenal cancer?
Our weekly lab panels track specific substances and hormones found in the blood that indicate the presence and activity level of adrenal cancer, helping our medical team adjust your protocol based on real-time physiological data.
7. Is Intratumoral Immunotherapy recommended for adrenal tumors?
Intratumoral Immunotherapy is an optional procedure ($6,200 - $7,200) that may be suggested for accessible tumors. The ITC medical board will evaluate your specific scans and case to determine if you are a candidate for this localized treatment.
8. Can I bring my own adrenal support supplements to the clinic?
All supplements and medications will be reviewed by the ITC doctors upon admission to ensure they align with your personalized treatment plan and do not interfere with the active alternative protocols.
